title.narrative: Financial Sector Reform and Strengthening Initiative (FIRST) Programmatic Multi Donor Trust Fund for Middle Income Countries

description.narrative: The objective of the Trust Fund is to support middle-income countries to improve the stability, efficiency, inclusiveness and depth of their financial sectors by providing medium-term technical assistance in prudential supervision, financial inclusion, and market development.
